verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the claim that teammates can 'hop in, watch it build, and weigh in' on a live preview. That suggests input during an active build, but it never says the input goes to the running agent or steers it without a restart. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sending follow-up instructions to a running agent session, a description of how mid-run steering works without restarting the task, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Anyone on the team can hop in, watch it build, and weigh in.
